### Thank you for being part of the GXO Innovation Tour 2026 in Almere.


It was a pleasure to welcome you for a day of inspiring conversations, innovation, and collaboration. Together, we explored how leading organizations are leveraging AI, automation, robotics, and data to shape the future of logistics.


We hope the experience sparked new ideas and valuable connections that will continue beyond the event.


## Leadership perspectives


**Turning innovation into performance at scale**


Go beyond the stage and explore Bart Beeks’ perspective on how GXO turns innovation, automation and AI into measurable performance at scale.


[Read full article](https://gxo.com/news_article/turning-innovation-into-performance-at-scale/)


**From intelligence to execution: Three shifts shaping the future of logistics**


Explore Paul Mohan’s perspective on three shifts bringing together AI, physical operations and human expertise to shape more responsive and resilient logistics.


[Read full article](https://gxo.com/news_article/three-shifts-shaping-the-future-of-logistics/)


## Your feedback


Your feedback helps us improve future GXO Innovation Tours and continue delivering valuable experiences. Please take a few minutes to share your thoughts and key takeaways.
